title: Understanding Confidence Intervals
text: Confidence intervals provide a range of values that likely contain the true parameter value. A 95% confidence interval means we are 95% confident that the true parameter lies within this range.

title: Interpreting Theta Intervals
text: The confidence intervals for theta parameters indicate the range of possible values for each parameter. If zero is within the interval, it suggests that the parameter might not have a significant effect.

title: $$\Theta_0$$ Interval
text: The confidence interval for $$\theta_0$$ is $$[44.808$$, $$45.013]$$. Since zero is not within this interval, $$\theta_0$$ is likely to have a significant effect.

title: $$\Theta_1$$ Interval
text: The confidence interval for $$\theta_1$$ is $$[-0.026$$, $$0.342]$$. Since zero is within this interval, $$\theta_1$$ might not have a significant effect.

title: $$\Theta_2$$ Interval
text: The confidence interval for $$\theta_2$$ is $$[-0.142$$, $$1.324]$$. Since zero is within this interval, $$\theta_2$$ might not have a significant effect.
